headline: ctree4113 climbs 1,270 places into ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: ctree4113 climbed from 1,355th to 85th, gaining 4.31 points to reach 34.03.
The move puts ctree4113 inside the top 100 on a board where the gold line sits at 16th.
